meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自查并单审已完成工作，核验目标、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚完成功能开发，想在提交PR前做一次独立的把关审查。
copy.tagline_en: Gate-check completed work with a single reviewer before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just finished coding and want an independent check before a PR handoff.

howto.what: 实现完成后,Claude 会先在真实界面自己跑手工 QA 并留证据,再只启动一个审查子代理,核对目标、约束、代码质量、安全和 QA 证据。QA 无失败行且该审查返回 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前,或你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。

say.text: PR 交接前,帮我审查这次已完成的工作
say.note: 先跑真实界面 QA,再启动一个 gate reviewer

say.text: 对刚改完的代码跑手工 QA 和 gate review
say.note: 任一 QA 行失败就直接判 REVIEW FAILED

say.text: 审查这个分支的改动,核对目标、约束和安全
say.note: 结论只有 APPROVE 或 REVIEW FAILED

howto.what_en: After implementation, Claude runs manual QA on the real surface, then launches one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, and QA evidence. It passes only if no QA row fails and the reviewer returns APPROVE.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Before the PR handoff, review the work I just finished
say_en.note: Runs manual QA first, then one gate reviewer

say_en.text: Run manual QA and a gate review on the code I just changed
say_en.note: Any failing QA row ends it as REVIEW FAILED

say_en.text: Review this branch's changes against goal, constraints, and security
say_en.note: Verdict is APPROVE or REVIEW FAILED only
